mapper.select: SELECT kind, name, place_count, review_count, lat, lng, image_url FROM ( SELECT kind, name, COUNT(*) AS place_count, SUM(COALESCE(review_count, 0)) AS review_count, AVG(latitude) AS lat, AVG(longitude) AS lng, (ARRAY_AGG(image_url ORDER BY COALESCE(review_count, 0) DESC) FILTER (WHERE image_url IS NOT NULL))[1] AS image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(review_count, 0)) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC) AS area_rank FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN base.kind = 'culture' THEN 'tour' ELSE base.kind END AS kind, split_part(base.address, ' ', 2) AS name, base.review_count, base.latitude, base.longitude, base.image_url FROM ( SELECT address, review_count, latitude, longitude, image_url, AS kind FROM retrip_place WHERE address LIKE '서울%' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL ) base WHERE base.kind IN ('cafe', 'food', 'bar', 'tour', 'culture') ) places WHERE name LIKE '%구' GROUP BY kind, name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) ranked WHERE area_rank <= #{limit} ORDER BY kind, area_rank

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE place.kind = 'food') AS food, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE place.kind = 'cafe') AS cafe, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE place.kind IN ('tour', 'culture')) AS tour FROM (SELECT AS kind FROM retrip_place WHERE address LIKE '서울%') AS place
SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE ST_Within(geom::geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{geometry}), 4326)) AND COALESCE(rating, 4.0) >= 3.0 ORDER BY COALESCE(review_count, 0) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
